pr_title: Always use beatmap ruleset in editor gameplay test mode
pr_body:
- Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/18084
- Alternative to / closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/18317

issue_context.title: Editor test play inherits current ruleset instead of beatmap's ruleset
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

When entering the editor, everything seems to be fine with the correct ruleset being fetched and applied. however, upon playtesting the beatmap, instead of the player using the correct ruleset for the beatmap, it chooses the current ruleset you have selected in the toolbar. 

### Screenshots or videos

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35349837/166618184-be238772-3a5c-4ca1-a571-305f94756995.mp4

### Version

2022.501.0

### Logs

Not entirely sure this is needed for this scenario.

[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8617678/runtime.log)
comments: This does look like an issue which should be fixed, but I do wonder if it's going to be seen as a regression from users that use the editor to "practice" a beatmap. Probably out of scope for now (said mode should be introduced in the standard play flow, not the editor flow) but worth noting.

review_comments:
`Beatmap.Value` can't possibly be a `DummyWorkingBeatmap` in editor, can it? `Editor` creates a new working beatmap if it sees it being selected:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/f8830c6850128456266c82de83273204f8b74ac0/osu.Game/Screens/Edit/Editor.cs#L154-L170
It can and not having this change fails tests. This is `EditorLoader`, not `Editor`.
~~Aha, so it's done for tests and not real in-game scenarios.~~ Nevermind, I misunderstood this class.

I would've updated the ruleset on `Editor` entrance since the entire screen should never operate on a different ruleset than the beatmap's one, but I think we can have it local to test gameplay until that actually proves to be an issue.
Again, this is `EditorLoader`. It is pushed *before* the editor. It does not load the player.
I feel like this will fix one other issue that may have been reported in the past... but maybe that was fixed in some other way already.
